brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.

requirements.evidence: Four Hex base Full pieces in a straight row at (0,0),(1,0),(2,0),(3,0) level 0, each holding a drained third-depth bin filled with soil and planted (prop:1 to prop:4).

requirements.requirement: Water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell
requirements.evidence: One run (run:run-1, mode irrigation) starts at (0,0), enters from edge 3 and passes through (1,0), (2,0) and (3,0), so the pipe runs through all four bases. Check_build is clean with meshClash clear.

requirements.requirement: Build is sound and fits (house rules)
requirements.evidence: capOpenFaces added solid end caps on the open faces, lockJoints added joint bolts on the joints; check_build reports no issues and no prop warnings.

requirements.requirement: Water-safe / potable water or material suitability
requirements.evidence: The configurator checks fit only. The run is set to irrigation (non-potable) mode, which is the default the planter uses; I did not set it to potable. Material suitability for wet use is not something the configurator can verify.

finish.summary: Built a four-cell planter: four full hex bases in a row, each with a drained third-depth bin, soil and a plant, and one irrigation pipe run passing through all four bases to feed every cell. Caps and joint bolts are applied and check_build is clean. Note the pipe is an irrigation (non-potable) run; the configurator does not verify water safety or materials.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: 1 run IRRIGATION: non-potable supply. Corners are flexible hose, glued into Sch 40 sockets, one coupling wherever hose meets rigid pipe.

Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
